description: CREATE OR REPLACE for functions and procedures: first-time create, replacing an existing one, the plain CREATE refusing a duplicate, IF NOT EXISTS not replacing, OR REPLACE + IF NOT EXISTS refused as incompatible options (live-verified sentence), schema-qualified replacement, and repeated replacement. Converted 1:1 from ddl/CreateOrReplaceFunctionTest and CreateOrReplaceProcedureTest (both now retired; they ran over JDBC but were pure SQL). The function different-schema test uses orf_schema instead of the Java literal test_schema, which already exists as the testkit reset schema.

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_numbers(a INTEGER, b INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'a + b'
CREATE FUNCTION multiply_numbers(a INTEGER, b INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'a * b'
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION multiply_numbers(a INTEGER, b INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'a * b * 2'
CREATE FUNCTION subtract_numbers(a INTEGER, b INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'a - b'
CREATE FUNCTION subtract_numbers(a INTEGER, b INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'b - a'
CREATE FUNCTION divide_numbers(a INTEGER, b INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'a / b'
CREATE FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS divide_numbers(a INTEGER, b INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'b / a'
CREATE FUNCTION double_number(n INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'n * 2'
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS double_number(n INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'n * 3'

error.messageContains: options IF NOT EXISTS and OR REPLACE are incompatible

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orf_schema.square(n INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'n * n * n'

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE format_name(name VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR AS 'BEGIN RETURN ''Dr. '' || name; END;'
